bullets.text: Ofcom Greenlights Satellite Services - **Ofcom** allows mobile operators to deliver satellite services directly to smartphones, enhancing connectivity.
Deutsche Telekom's AI Ambitions - **Deutsche Telekom** partners with **OpenAI** to enhance network operations and customer service with AI.
Nokia Job Cuts Spark Protests - **Nokia** faces backlash as hundreds of jobs are cut across Europe, igniting protests.
AI-RAN Optimisation Validated - **Samsung** and **KT** demonstrate AI-driven network optimisation, reducing connection failures significantly.
Vodafone's Automated Testing - **Vodafone** partners with **Spirent** to fast-track software rollout for its 5G voice core network.
Cloudflare Outage Raises Concerns - Recent **Cloudflare** outage highlights vulnerabilities in enterprise infrastructure reliance.
AI-Powered Cyber Defense Centers - **NTT DATA** launches new AI-driven Cyber Defense Centers to enhance cybersecurity resilience.
Private 5G Growth Accelerates - **Ericsson** reports private 5G is outpacing Wi-Fi, driven by high-value industrial applications.
